name: UK strikes & disruption
value: No national strike; Tube strikes from 26 Nov
summary: No national-scale strike found for this week; RMT London Underground driver strikes start 26 Nov
state: The RMT has called eight 24-hour London Underground driver strikes over new working arrangements, starting at noon on 26 Nov, then on 17 and 19 Dec and into January and February (ITV News, 6 Nov). An RMT strike at Chiltern Railways on 12 Nov was regional (RaillyNews). Searches on 18 Nov found no national-scale strike or nationwide infrastructure disruption due this week, so the signal stays Normal.
for_you: London commuters face Tube disruption from noon on 26 Nov; Transport for London and National Rail Enquiries publish service updates. No national disruption is expected this week.
